cards.name: GORD Gordon
cards.power: TLOSR Breach — Bypasses all crural diaphragm defenses via GABA-B mediated vago-vagal reflexes.
cards.lore: PPIs must be taken 30-60 minutes before meals to target the H+/K+-ATPase in activated parietal cells.

cards.name: Barrett's Bernie
cards.power: Columnar Shift — Adapts to acid, initiating the SMAD4 carcinogenic sequence.
cards.lore: Intrinsic factor, secreted exclusively by parietal cells, is the absolute sole source of B12 absorption.
cards.notes: Lore may belong to adjacent card; OCR ambiguous on page 2 right-column boundary

cards.name: [name not legible]
cards.power: CDH1 E-Cadherin Loss — Triggers hereditary diffuse gastric cancer and linitis plastica.
cards.lore: TCGA molecular profiling dictates treatment; HER2 amplification uniquely allows for trastuzumab targeting.
cards.notes: Character name not legible

cards.name: UGIB [surname not captured]
cards.power: Restrictive Transfusion — Starving the bleed. Liberal transfusion actively worsens variceal pressure.
cards.lore: Terlipressin + Antibiotics + EVL reduces mortality. Antibiotics specifically prevent SBP translocation.
cards.notes: Surname not captured in OCR; first initials 'UGIB A' visible

cards.name: Coeliac Zoe
cards.power: tTG2 Deamidation — Converts gliadin into high-affinity peptides for DQ2/DQ8 presentation to Th1 cells.
cards.lore: Iron is absorbed in the duodenum; adult coeliac almost always presents first as iron-deficiency anaemia.

cards.name: Dysphagia Dmitri
cards.power: Solids-First Progression — Indicates mechanical obstruction (carcinoma/stricture) over motility failure.
cards.lore: Solids-only progressing to liquids = mechanical; both from onset = motility disorder (achalasia/spasm).

cards.name: Crohn's Charlie
cards.power: Deep Infiltration — Bypasses mucosal boundaries to cause strictures, fistulae, and creeping fat.
cards.lore: Terminal ileum loss specifically causes B12 deficiency AND gallstones (due to bile salt pool depletion).

cards.name: Ulcerative Colitis Uma
cards.power: Crypt Abscess — Neutrophilic assault restricted entirely to the superficial mucosal layer. No skip lesions.
cards.lore: Patients with both UC and PSC require annual colonoscopy surveillance from diagnosis.

cards.name: Small Bowel Sam
cards.power: Bile Deconjugation — Ruins micelle formation, causing massive fat malabsorption and steatorrhoea.
cards.lore: Bacteria consume B12 but produce folate; SIBO characteristically presents as B12 deficiency with elevated folate.

cards.name: Carcinoid Carlos
cards.power: Hepatic Bypass — Syndrome only occurs when liver metastases evade MAO-A detoxification.
cards.lore: The left heart is spared from fibrotic valve plaques because the lungs contain MAO-A which destroys serotonin.

cards.name: Short Bowel Sebastian
cards.power: GLP-2 Hyperplasia — Triggers massive enterocyte adaptation and bowel dilatation to salvage nutrients.
cards.lore: Retaining the colon allows colonic bacteria to ferment carbohydrates into SCFAs, salvaging up to 1500 kcal/day.

cards.name: [name not legible]
cards.power: FXR Negative Feedback — Suppresses CYP7A1 via FGF-19 to stop cholesterol conversion.
cards.lore: Type 2 BAM occurs when FGF-19 fails, causing unsuppressed bile acid synthesis and severe watery diarrhoea.
cards.notes: Character name not legible

cards.name: [name not legible]
cards.power: Serotonin Peristalsis — EC cells release 95% of the body's serotonin to drive motility.
cards.lore: Ondansetron works as an antiemetic specifically by blocking 5-HT3 receptors on vagal afferents.
cards.notes: Character name not legible; condition inferred from EC cell serotonin peristalsis

cards.name: [name not legible]
cards.power: Heyde's Cleavage — Aortic stenosis high shear stress destroys HMW vWF, causing angiodysplasia bleeds.
cards.lore: Diverticular bleeding is arterial, painless, and large-volume; mostly occurring in the right colon.
cards.notes: Character name not legible

cards.name: Colorectal Cancer Colin
cards.power: KRAS Resistance — Constitutive pathway activation entirely ignores upstream blockade.
cards.lore: Cancers with a KRAS mutation are intrinsically resistant to anti-EGFR therapies like cetuximab.

cards.name: Diverticular Dina
cards.power: Hinchey Rupture — Progresses from micro-perforation to purulent/faecal peritonitis requiring Hartmann's.
cards.lore: Recent RCTs confirm antibiotics are not necessary for uncomplicated acute diverticulitis.

cards.name: Colonic Polyps Perry
cards.power: Sessile Serration — Feeds the traditional APC pathway vs BRAF and MLH1 methylation (MSI).
cards.lore: Sessile serrated lesions are particularly dangerous due to flat morphology and rapid malignant potential.

cards.name: [name not legible]
cards.power: NSAID Trigger — Chemical induction of chronic, watery, non-bloody nocturnal diarrhoea in older women.
cards.lore: A perfectly normal colonoscopy in chronic watery diarrhoea mandates random biopsies to check for this.
cards.notes: Character name not legible

cards.name: IBD Extra-Intestinal Eva
cards.power: Pathergy — Trauma accelerates destruction; surgical debridement of pyoderma gangrenosum is disastrous.
cards.lore: Some manifestations parallel gut activity (erythema nodosum), while others (uveitis, AS, PSC) run completely independently.

cards.name: Liver Function Louisa
cards.power: Phase II Glucuronidation — Renders toxic hydrophobic compounds water-soluble via UGT1A1 for biliary excretion.
cards.lore: INR is a much better marker of acute synthetic failure than albumin due to clotting factors' short half-lives.

cards.name: Jaundice Jerome
cards.power: Urobilinogen Starvation — Biliary obstruction prevents bilirubin from reaching the gut to become stercobilin.
cards.lore: Dark urine + pale stools + absent urinary urobilinogen uniquely identifies complete post-hepatic obstruction.

cards.name: Cirrhosis Cyrus
cards.power: TGF-B Fibrogenesis — Permanently replaces healthy parenchyma with regenerative nodules.
cards.lore: First decompensation event drops median survival from 12 years to just 2 years.

cards.name: [name not legible]
cards.power: GABAergic Tone Surge — Neurosteroids and ammonia induce extreme sedation; benzos are lethal.
cards.lore: Never restrict protein in HE; sarcopenia worsens outcomes. Treat with lactulose and rifaximin.
cards.notes: Character name not legible; condition identified from GABAergic Tone Surge power

cards.name: Ascites Antonia
cards.power: Opsonin Failure — Low ascites protein (<15 g/L) allows translocated E. coli to trigger Spontaneous Bacterial Peritonitis.
cards.lore: IV Albumin given with antibiotics for SBP drastically reduces mortality by preventing Type 1 Hepatorenal Syndrome.

cards.name: ALD Albert
cards.power: [power text not captured in OCR — CYP2E1 Induction inferred from lore context]
cards.lore: Chronic alcohol induces CYP2E1, drastically lowering the toxic threshold for paracetamol overdose.
cards.notes: Power name not legible; lore clearly captured

cards.name: NAFLD/NASH Nathan
cards.power: PNPLA3 I148M Mutation — Halts triglyceride hydrolysis, causing massive lipid droplet accumulation.
cards.lore: The fastest growing cause for transplant; weight loss >10% can actually regress fibrosis.

cards.name: Viral Hep Victor
cards.power: cccDNA Integration — HBV integrates permanently into the host genome, making true cure nearly impossible.
cards.lore: HCV is an RNA virus treated with DAAs for a complete cure; HBV requires lifelong suppression.

cards.name: AIH/PBC [surname unclear]
cards.power: Pyruvate Dehydrogenase Cross-React — Autoantibodies destroy bile ducts while sparing hepatocytes.
cards.lore: Pruritus is severe due to TGR5 activation by bile salts; UDCA slows ductular damage.
cards.notes: Surname not legible; OCR suggests 'Marie' or similar

cards.name: [name not legible]
cards.power: Hepcidin Failure — HFE mutation ruins iron sensing, causing unchecked intestinal iron absorption.
cards.lore: Causes Bronze Diabetes due to iron deposition in the pancreas; HCC risk persists even after venesection.
cards.notes: Character name not legible

cards.name: DILI Davina
cards.power: NAPQI Necrosis — Overwhelms glutathione stores to cause massive centrilobular hepatocyte death.
cards.lore: NAC is only effective for paracetamol overdose if given early, before irreversible covalent binding occurs.

cards.name: Wilson's Wilma
cards.power: ATP7B Defect — Blocks biliary copper excretion, causing accumulation in the basal ganglia and liver.
cards.lore: A disproportionately low ALP with markedly elevated bilirubin is highly characteristic of acute Wilson's crisis.

cards.name: Gallstones Gertie
cards.power: Supersaturation — Depleted bile acid pools or excess cholesterol cause physical crystal nucleation.
cards.lore: Charcot's triad becomes Reynold's pentad (adding hypotension + confusion) marking lethal septic shock.

cards.name: Cholangiocarcinoma Clare
cards.power: FGFR2 Fusion — Molecular target allowing specific inhibition with pemigatinib in intrahepatic subtypes.
cards.lore: PSC carries a 1500x relative risk for CCA due to chronic fibro-inflammatory duct destruction.

cards.name: Pancreatitis Pablo
cards.power: Zymogen Activation — Premature intracellular cleavage triggers massive local and systemic inflammatory cascades.
cards.lore: Enteral feeding (NG/NJ) is superior to TPN as it preserves gut barrier and stops necrotic infection.

cards.name: [name not legible]
cards.power: Type 3c Brittle Diabetes — Complete destruction of both insulin AND glucagon cells causes wild glucose swings.
cards.lore: B12 malabsorption occurs because the acidic duodenum (from lack of bicarb) disrupts the IF-B12 complex.
cards.notes: Character name not legible

cards.name: [name not legible]
cards.power: Stromal Exclusion — KRAS-driven microenvironment physically prevents drug delivery and checkpoint inhibitors.
cards.lore: Painless obstructive jaundice with a palpable non-tender gallbladder (Courvoisier's) is PDAC until proven otherwise.
cards.notes: Character name not legible

cards.name: GI Bleed Emergency Gemma
cards.power: Restrictive Trigger — Hb 70-80 g/L is the optimal target; pushing more fluid pops the clots.
cards.lore: Unlike in trauma, Tranexamic Acid (TXA) has no mortality benefit in GI bleeding (HALT-IT trial).

cards.name: Gut Microbiome Mike
cards.power: Colonisation Resistance — Healthy flora outcompetes C. difficile for space and nutrients.
cards.lore: Faecal microbiota transplant (FMT) boasts an 85-90% success rate by restoring the destroyed ecological niche.

cards.name: [name not legible]
cards.power: Step-Up Debridement — Endoscopic transgastric drainage dominates over primary open surgical necrosectomy.
cards.lore: Splenic vein thrombosis from body/tail pancreatitis causes isolated gastric varices without portal hypertension.
cards.notes: Character name not legible

cards.name: Refeeding Nadia
cards.power: Intracellular Shift — Sudden phosphate release from feeding forces phosphate into cells causing cardiac failure.
cards.lore: Never restrict protein in cirrhosis; late evening snack reduces overnight muscle catabolism.

cards.power: Field Cancerisation — Shared carcinogen exposure creates synchronous field defects across the entire mucosa.
